result:
I fixed 11 rules in `pricebook.py` that didn't match their docstrings. I then checked all 150 rules by brute-force comparison against a reference implementation built from the docstrings, and none differ now.

| Rule | Problem → fix |
|---|---|
| 11, 150 | Labelled whole but the discount only counted units above the threshold → discount now applies to all units |
| 96, 128 | Labelled marginal but the discount applied to all units → discount now applies only to units above the threshold |
| 12 | Cap only applied when the discount exceeded 60,000 won → cap now always applies |
| 20, 56, 70 | Cap was applied to the price before the percentage → cap now applies to the discount |
| 107 | Used 3% → changed to 2% |
| 120, 136 | Used 6% → changed to 5% |

Rule 101 uses `qty > 12` instead of `>= 12`. At exactly 12 units a marginal discount is 0 anyway, so it behaves the same and I left it as is.

STATUS: DONE
